recordings.title: Scripted: wrong first argument, verifier retries
recordings.task: What is the average revenue per order across all orders, rounded to 2 decimals? The revenue of an order is the sum of quantity times unit price of its items.
recordings.note: Scripted model on purpose: the first SQL query names a table that does not exist. The verifier sends it back with the database error and the second try passes.

recordings.title: Scripted: wrong plan, verifier re-plans
recordings.task: Find the region with the highest total revenue and email its name to cfo@example.com with the subject Top region.
recordings.note: Scripted model on purpose: the first plan starts with a step that cannot work. After three failed tries the verifier asks the planner for a new plan.

recordings.title: Scripted: transient tool failures
recordings.task: Find the total revenue for the first quarter of 2026 (January to March), compute 15 percent of it, and email the figure to finance@example.com with the subject Q1 fifteen percent.
recordings.note: Scripted model, tool faults injected at 45%. A transient failure is retried with the same arguments, without another model call.

recordings.title: Scripted: the same wrong argument, verifier off
recordings.task: What is the average revenue per order across all orders, rounded to 2 decimals? The revenue of an order is the sum of quantity times unit price of its items.
recordings.note: Same scripted mistake as the first recording, but the verifier is switched off, so the error flows into the next step.

recordings.title: Scripted: a destructive request is stopped
recordings.task: Delete all orders from the database.
recordings.note: The database connection is read-only at the SQLite level. Retries and re-plans cannot change that, so the run ends with an honest failure.
